description:
Are you an experienced Python Developer with a passion for big data processing and cloud computing? Lim Media, a full-service digital agency with offices in New York and Cairo, is seeking a talented developer to join our growing team.

As a key member of our development team, you will be responsible for designing and implementing large scale data processing solutions and leading the development of data pipelines to support business-critical applications. Responsibilities:
• Design, develop, and maintain data pipelines for processing and storing large volumes of data
• Work with stakeholders to identify requirements for data processing and storage solutions
• Implement data processing solutions using Python with a focus on performance, scalability, and stability
• Collaborate with other team members to develop and maintain a comprehensive data processing infrastructure
• Develop, test, and deploy data processing solutions in cloud environments such as AWS, Azure, or GCP
• Monitor and maintain data processing pipelines to ensure optimal function and troubleshoot issues as needed
• Stay current with the latest technologies and trends in big data processing and cloud computing

Requirements:
• 8+ years of experience as a Data Engineer
• Expertise in coding in Python
• Experience with at least one cloud platform: AWS, Azure, GCP, Snowflake, DataBricks
• Experience with data wrangling, ETL and big data processing
• Excellent communication skills
• Experience with managing a team
• Good working knowledge of data structures

Nice to have:
• Expertise in PySpark
• Expertise in AWS data platform (Kinesis, Glue, Lambda functions)
• Experience with DataBricks
• Experience with database systems (SQL and NoSQL) such as Redshift, RDBMS, DynamoDB, and S3
• Experience with Apache Flink
• Knowledge with monitoring and logging in AWS services such as X-Ray, Cloudwatch

This is a remote position, open to candidates in LATAM, USA, and APAC with 7 years of cloud experience and at least 2 years of Python experience. We offer a competitive salary package and the opportunity to work with a talented and dynamic team.

If you meet the requirements and have a passion for big data processing and cloud computing, please apply and let us know why you are the perfect fit for this role

Keyo is looking for a highly experienced Computer Vision engineer and Neural Network architect to join our team to help us continue to evolve the biometric capture systems that provide the foundation for biometric authentication within the Keyo network. Specifically, the candidate will be an important member in building computer vision software to match palm images on a massive scale for authentication in real-world environments. Significant core neural network experience / research orientated and familiar with state of the art tech in neural network architecture

Candidates will be asked to provide their accomplishments and experience in the above as a pre-requisite for interview

Confidence Gap
We know the confidence gap and imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting spectacular candidates, so please don’t hesitate to apply — we’d love to hear from you.

About Keyo
We are building a company that reflects the world in which we want to live. One where we can enjoy the convenience of biometrics without compromising our privacy or personal freedom. To make this a reality, our technology allows businesses of all kinds to adopt biometric authentication quickly and easily. With Keyo, people are clocking into work, paying for a coffee, and unlocking doors with a wave of their hand. Our team is remote first, by design. Our talented employees work from all over the world because we want Keyo to reflect the people who use it: global citizens who bring their diverse perspectives to solve unique problems.
We are at an exciting juncture and looking for new voices and ideas to continue building our vision for the company. Keyo believes that the things that make us unique are our greatest strengths. We have an inclusive, global, remote-first workplace that comprises people from all different lifestyles, backgrounds, abilities, and nationalities.
Please note: Keyo is undergoing SOC2 compliance and performs background checks, and provides security training to team members.

Develop a web-based application that uses a database of past indoor temperatures, outdoor temperatures (via API) and a user-entered current temperature to predict the minimum indoor temperature in the next 14 hours.
This MVP will use a simplified algorithm. If successful, future versions will have more features and use the full algorithm.

Deadline: July 2023 (negotiable). 

Terms and conditions: Payment on time and materials basis, monthly in arrears, with payment within 30 days of invoice (negotiable).

Budget for MVP: US$500-$1000 negotiable. Future work likely if successful.

Client owns all work and IP. Non-disclosure terms apply [legal wording to be added before statement of work signed]. 

Back end: 
• Preference is to write back-end code in Python, though open to alternatives if it suits the overall project. Will need skikit-learn and other basic libraries. 
• Establish database with space for up to 700 records and 45 fields of string or floats values, though a smaller database may suffice for this MVP. 
• Somewhere to host the database and web page

Front-end: 
• Preference is for the app to be a responsive web page (probably JavaScript). 
• Draft wireframe provided to interested contractors. Some features (such as location permission) can be ‘faked’ for the MVP). 

You will be provided with:
• Client’s attempt at Python code which contains basic program logic
• Past data in Excel table (or Python array)
• Key for Visual Crossing Weather API (or other suitable weather API if desired)

Data Engineer

About the Role

Location: Remote, Residing in Australia (Melbourne/Sydney) 
Reports to: Program Manager and CTO
Type: Fixed Term Contract
Duration: 6+ months

Role Purpose

The Data Engineer will design, build and integrate data from multiple sources in order to prepare a trusted data infrastructure that supports the data and analytics capabilities for one of our clients. This position develops the processes for data acquisition, transformation, migration, verification, modelling and mining. 
The core purpose of this position will be to migrate data over from an AWS Redshift instance to a new greenfield Snowflake instance. This will include, but not limited to, building SQL/Python scripts/processes, designing/modelling the environment, orchestration, and integrations.

Key Responsibilities
• Analysis of stored procedures, functions, views, and other SQL objects.
• Analysis of Tableau reports/dashboards and their corresponding data sources.
• Translating reports into data and functional requirements.
• Designing and data modelling the to-be platform.
• Building of SQL code to process data between layers (Bronze, Silver, Gold) and apply transformations.
• Orchestration of SQL code using Airlfow and/or Talend.
• Organizing and managing tasks through a Scrum Agile methodology.
• Running UAT sessions with end stakeholders.
• Deployments of code between environments. This will also include DevOps integration through Bit Bucket.
• Writing of solution documentation and supporting maintenance of developed solutions.
• Executing test scripts and unit tests of developed code within the environment.
• Collaboration with overall project team and business stakeholders.

Essential Knowledge, Skills, and Experience

• Bachelor’s Degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, Mathematics, Actuary or a similar related field.
• Minimum 3 years of experience as a Data Engineer designing, building, and optimizing data pipelines, architecture and data sets.
• Extensive experience in building processes supporting data transformation, data structures and the manipulation, processing and extraction of value from datasets.
• Extensive experience using SQL and Python.
• Experience with data pipeline and workflow management tools, and Cloud data platforms.
• Knowledge of data platform concepts such as data lakes, data warehousing, big data
• processing, real time processing architecture, scheduling, and monitoring of ETL/ELT workflows.
• Experience with Snowflake and Relational Databases.
• Experience with Talend and/or Airflow would be highly advantageous.
• Knowledge of Agile Software Development methodologies.
• Strong organizing and prioritizing skills with the ability to work across multiple work streams simultaneously.
• Strong process orientation with solid documentation skills.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

description:

We are using YOLOv7 to calculate the three-dimensional pose points of a person. When the image is passed to Yolo for inference, the non-max suppression creates a bottleneck in the whole inference pipeline.

The Mediapipe runs on the CPU while the rest of the model inference is done on the GPU. We have deployed the model for live inference in Flask, but we are only getting up to 7-8 FPS on the local RTX 3090.

We are looking for an individual who can look at the code and improve its performance. Please reach out if you are experienced with this. Thanks!

description:
We are seeking an experienced designer to join our team and work on updating our React web application that integrates OpenAI and Midjourney AI bots with ecommerce and NFT platforms. As a designer, you will play a critical role in helping us create an engaging and user-friendly experience for our customers.

The application will offer various prompt methodologies for the AI systems, including Single input, List input, Ask us to give you some options, and Upload photos for edit. These features will allow users to input a sentence or a few lists, and the app will create a combination of inputs and outputs that can generate a large number of images. Users will also be able to upload a photo for DALLE to edit, with text prompts to help them edit the photo based on their input.

Your role will involve designing the application's user interface and experience, ensuring that it is visually appealing, easy to use, and engaging. You will work closely with our development team to ensure that the design is implemented effectively, and you will have the opportunity to collaborate with other designers to create a cohesive and consistent design across the application.

Additionally, the application will handle automatic product uploads to Opensea and Printful in a similar way to automation.merchtitans.com (by web scraping). Users will be required to upload a product template with the correct positioning, and the automated system will upload their custom AI-produced image to their store.

Users will also be able to directly upload the product or add it to a section on their "drop/queue" manager. NFTs are generally "dropped", where all the product uploads happen at once. Some ecommerce platforms, such as Etsy, require a delayed upload, and therefore our users should put their products in a queue that uploads their products at a random interval set by the user.

As a designer, you will have the opportunity to create the product forms that users will fill in to specialize their product titles, descriptions, and provide any additional information such as pricing. You will also have the chance to design the product upload process and create a visually engaging and intuitive form for users to upload their product templates.

The application will integrate Stripe for both per-image payments and a percentage of NFT and ecommerce sales, with billing taking place on a monthly basis. Your role will include designing the payment system, ensuring that it is easy to use and visually appealing, and that it integrates seamlessly with the rest of the application.

If you are an experienced designer with a strong background in creating engaging and user-friendly experiences for web applications, and you are excited about the opportunity to work on a cutting-edge project that integrates AI with ecommerce and NFT platforms, we would love to hear from you. Please submit examples of your work and a cover letter explaining why you are the right fit for this role.

title: Create data models from existing and apply ML to aid in prediction
description:
Our company ingests json data, applies a set of rules to it and outputs the resultant data classified into an existing industry standard classification system.

These rules are applied by an engine that essentially says, “if (value in json === ‘foo’) then (output1=’foo apple’, output2=’foo orange’). The rules engine algorithm pulls from a database table of known matches, and we update the table on an as-needed basis with new rules.

We have a considerable amount of ‘before (json)’ data and resultant outputs.

At the highest level, we are looking for help in developing an ML solution that will learn from these mappings and from future json data, getting better as it goes. 

A future, ML-informed iteration might then see ‘fooo’ in the json data and reasonably output then (output1=’foo apple’, output2=’foo orange’), as it predicted fooo is most likely foo.

Of course, much more detailed data and information are available for the project upon its start.

We envision this engagement as first, to determine how to structure the data properly to achieve the above; next, implementing an ML solution using that defined data and giving us the results we seek.

title: Migrate Power BI data source from Excel to database
description:
We have the following situation to be addressed: a client provided some PowerBI dashboards that take some Microsoft Excel spreadsheet as datasource. The client ask us to move these data to a propper database (PostgreSQL database).

WHAT WE HAVE DONE AT THE MOMENT: we used a tool named DAX Studio (https://daxstudio.org/) to extract a database data table structure from the Power BI dashboard (it allowed us to obtain tables for Microsoft SQL Server database). So at the moment we have a database schema (containing data) obtained from the Power BI dashboard provided by the client.
We installed and configured Power BI Data Gateway tool in order to use our on premises database as data source instead the Excel spreadsheets.

WHAT WE NEED:

- First of all we need to understand if this is the right path to take.

- The Power BI dashboard contains some "calculated fields" implemented in DAX (Data Analysis Expressions) formula language. We need a way to do a porting of these fields from DAX to SQL. We had a couple of ideas: 1) add these calculated fields as new table fields. 2) Implement stored procedures that do these calculation. The new version of Power BI dashboard will call these stored procedure in order to obtain these data.
Both the previous solution imply a conversion of the DAX expressions to SQL language. We need someone that help us to define what is the best solution and that help us to implement this.

- Some effort to adapt the existing Power BI dasboard (that at the moment use the Excel spreadsheet as data source) in order to use the new database structure as data source.

title: Face Detection and masking
description:
Here are full Requirements:

1. Detect all the Faces present in an image.
2. Masking all the Faces according to the bounding box.
3. Save the masked images in a database. (No input image is available after this step.
* When you develop the masking method, must consider unmasking for a selected person.
* FYI.. from simple masking methods (like blur) it is hard to restore the original face.
4. A target face is given. We have to find the target face from the masked images and Unmask only the selected person.

An example scenario:

Imagine input as CCTV live video stream. We get the input data from it.

Mask (any kind of masking blur etc) the all the detected faces and save only masked images.

You can save the facial features of each face detected, time of detection, frame number and corresponding bounding box.

Later we get a new face, finds it’s facial features using same algorithm which is used to find face and extract their features from raw/live input images.

We match them with the existing features, read the corresponding bounding box and unmask only that region in the masked image.

Later this project needs to run on live cctv videos where all the detected faces are masked and on request of concerned authority we unmask only the target face and revel identity. 

I already have reference code for the task just in case if you needed. I need to finish this by Sunday 7th Feb

title: Human Workflow to AI Automation Analyst/Consultant
description:
I am in need of a consultant or project workflow analyst that can review our current task performed manually and help determine the most cost-effective methods to efficiently automate the processes using our current platforms (teamwork and ZOHO CRM) or new technologies as recommended that can integrate with TW or ZOHO. 

We analyze the operations of niche healthcare businesses to determine the fair market value of these businesses based on the financial performance of the business and other metrics. 

Currently, much of the data is manually entered from forms into an excel spreadsheet where it is then manually reviewed against hundreds of data points for consistency. A list of questions is then created for the selling client against the data supplied. This data is then updated and a recommended listing price is provided to the client. The client then confirms the listing price and the data is then exported to a detailed business information package (PDF) that can then be shared with prospective buyers. 

I believe with the advent of AI that much of this can be automated to be performed autonomously and more accurately. In an ideal world- the AI (if used to manage this) would be able to learn from past clients and apply the same logic moving forward.

I do need this to be scalable and adaptable due to the ever-changing nature of the industry. 

Am I asking too much? 

Things that need to work together with this: Analysis of data from ZOHO CRM, Teamwork, Outlook. We also hold a plethora of data in other excel and google spreadsheets. 

In Short- I want to take ME out of the process as much as possible and Insert Automation and AI to perform the vast majority of the data analysis and presentation. 

Thanks for taking this much time. I have attached a video that shows the basics of what I do. But ultimately- I think someone would need to review the daily workflow I do to help determine the ways this can be automated.

title: Trade data analysis
description:
I am looking for assistance with a trade analysis project. 

The project is to acquire data from UN COMTRADE and then process it via comparison between different tariff regimes for trading partners for a group of countries.

The group and tariff rates to use would be identified to successful candidate. 

It is estimated at 8 days work.

STEP ONE
Using COMTRADE acquire data on global imports for a GROUP OF COUNTRIES as a group by value at 6 digit tariff code for sample year 2019.

STEP TWO 
Filter to top 100 imports by value (equating to minimum imports per line of approx. value of over 135,000 USD per annum for whole of GROUP OF COUNTRIES)

STEP THREE
Acquire the Applied MFN tariff being used in each of the countries within the GROUP for these top 100 tariffs and illustrate alongside the country specific tariff (to be provided) applied in 2023 and 2027.

STEP FOUR
Itemise for these 100 import lines the current MFN Applied rate, the Country specific duty rate for 2023 and the Country specific duty rate for 2027. 

STEP FIVE
Exclude all lines which are duty free under MFN Applied rate or which are excluded from country specific liberalisation. If less than 50 tariff lines remain, steps 1-5 above to be repeated until we have a minimum of 50 tariff lines to analyse. 

STEP SIX
Acquire country specific import data on those 100 import lines for each the 15 countries in the GROUP by volume and value; specifying top 3 MFN current exporters.

STEP SEVEN
Calculate unit cost per kg or litre for each tariff line

STEP EIGHT
Calculate Duty payable by unit under country specific agreement in 2023 and in 2027; and under Applied MFN per unit; and the total cost by volume/weight quoted for country specific agreement 2023, 2027 and MFN. 

STEP NINE
Calculate the Value of the switch in tariff for the GROUP buyer country from MFN to country specific tariff for 2023 and 2027 (total and by unit) 

STEP TEN
Produce abbreviated sheet illustrating the US dollar saving by unit and by total volume and giving a ranking of greatest saving by product line for each of 15 GROUP countries for 2023 and 2027.

title: In-House SEO for Link Building Focused SEO Agency
description:
Hi!

We run a fully remote link building focused SEO agency (linkflow.ai) focused on B2B Tech and SaaS clients and are looking for an SEO ninja to help improve our client results. We do both link building work and full SEO consulting. We do not need someone to go out and build links, we already do that in house. 

We are an exciting, fast growing company with ample opportunity for advancement and long-term compensation potential for someone who's great at the role and a good fit with our culture (fun, driven, entrepreneurial).

This is a part-time role with the potential to turn into full-time for the right person. We're looking for someone with experience creating strong results for national (non-local) businesses, and ideally experience as an in-house SEO. Our client companies are not local, so we are not looking for someone who’s a local SEO expert.

This role will start out at roughly 10-20 hours per week, with the potential for more hours and even full time, if it makes sense for both of us. 

**Prior to an interview, selected candidates will be required to complete an SEO assessment and submit a short video explaining the rationale for your recommendations.

Responsibilities:

-Determining effective SEO strategies for our clients and setting goals around keywords, pages, rankings

-Taking the lead on SEO consulting projects for clients (this means creating a plan, assisting the clients in executing the plan and fielding questions regarding it)

-Taking the lead role on performing “SEO Roadmaps” for clients (a detailed SEO audit and strategy)

-Quarterly reporting back to clients on the progress we’ve made on our SEO goals as well as identifying potential areas for improvement

-Communicating client details to our link operations team on Slack & Google Sheets regarding anchor text selection and pages to build links to

-Improving our own SEO (for our agency, Linkflow)

-Assisting our Sales Reps on the closing of sales when needed

Expectations:

-Be active on our Slack channel and fairly responsive - doesn’t have to be immediate, but ideally you can reply within a couple of hours.

-Join us on a regularly scheduled weekly meeting

-Occasionally email directly with our clients regarding SEO strategy, or on phone/Zoom calls as needed to explain things to them. 

-Hours don’t have to be strictly within 9-5, but availability during the normal working hours is ideal.

-Occasionally hop on calls with prospects to help explain SEO concepts to them

-Be professional and kick ass at SEO (No scrubs!)

Skills/Experience we’re looking for:

-At least 3 years of in-house SEO experience, ideally for a national (non-local) business

-We are looking for someone who truly loves SEO, stays on top of trends in the industry, etc.

-Excellent understanding of overall SEO - both on-page and off-page, and proven experience getting results for clients

-Solid understanding of link building, anchor text selection - this is a huge part of what we do

-Knowledge of GSC, GA, relevant SEO tools especially Ahrefs (we use that one a lot)

-Excellent communication skills and attention to detail

-Gets things done on time (if you say X will be good to go on Thursday, it gets done on Thursday)

-Authoritative when speaking about SEO. We want our clients to listen to you and immediately trust what you have to say.

Attributes we’re looking for:

-Think proactively to improve processes

-Ability to talk intelligently and convincingly in front of clients

-Always looking to learn and improve your SEO skills

-A solid understanding of link building and how it works

-Think proactively for ways to improve our client results, and potentially help turn existing link building clients into SEO consulting clients

-Friendly

-Roll up your sleeves and dig in mentality

Pay: 
-$50/hr to start, with potential raise at the 3-month mark upon good performance
-Generous commissions on top of base hourly pay

Perks:
-Flexible hours that work for your schedule (so long as you can make the regular meetings)
-Ample opportunity for advancement within the company
-Full access to Gotch SEO academy training program and community at our expense
-Fun and friendly team 
-Bosses who aren't micro-managers - as long as you get your sh*t done well, we’re happy!

If this sounds like a good fit, reply and we'll take it from there!

Thanks,
Josh

Solution Services Consultancy is a specialized IT service-providing company. We specialize in helping our clients in building the “Tech of the Future” such as:

We at Solution Services and Consultancy provide the highest standards of consultancy services, delivering value and excellence. It is with this vigor that we work meticulously to understand the requirements of our clients and establish perfect harmony between solution implementation and business consultancy. Our firm lives by the canon of cultivating long-term relationships, based on trust and integrity, with its most treasured assets - clients & employees. At SSC, ethics and best business practices are not just enforced, but celebrated! All of this, with the objective of becoming the most reliable and trusted business and solution consultancy firm, globally.

Job Description

We are looking for world-class talent to join a crack team of engineers, product managers, and designers. We want people who are passionate about creating software that makes a difference in the world. We like people who are brimming with ideas and who take initiative rather than wait to be told what to do. We prize a team-first mentality, personal responsibility, and tenacity to solve hard problems and meet deadlines. As part of a small and lean team, you will have a very direct impact on the success of the company. As a data engineer, you will:

•Design, develop, and maintain an infrastructure for streaming, processing, and storage of data. Build tools for effective maintenance and monitoring of the data infrastructure.

•Contribute to key data pipeline architecture decisions and lead the implementation of major initiatives.

•Work closely with stakeholders to develop scalable and performant solutions for their data requirements, including extraction, transformation, and loading of data from a range of data sources.

●Experience with stream-processing systems (e.g. Storm, Spark Streaming), big data querying tools (e.g. Pig, Hive, Spark), and data serialization frameworks (e.g. Protobuf, Thrift, Avro).

title: Senior Delphi Developer - Cybersecurity
description:
Emsisoft is currently seeking new employees to expand its client software development team.
 
Job description:

You will be responsible for improving and maintaining business logic, service and UI components of Emsisoft endpoint protection products, that help users around the world to remove malware from their systems and stay protected. Malware is constantly evolving and developing new tricks and techniques to avoid detection or make removal more difficult, so expect to be challenged daily with finding new and creative ways to counteract new malware defense mechanisms.

This is a full time remote position and you will be working from home.

Responsibilities:

* Primary responsibility is focused on development and maintenance work related to new and existing Emsisoft's Windows client software components. This involves everything from minor code changes to design of new modules, including writing code, debugging, testing, and documentation.

* Ability to develop written design specifications from project management input, discussions with key team members and customer feedback.

* Complete documentation and provide input to improve procedures for installation, development and maintenance processes.

Skills and qualifications:

* Strong background in Delphi development (3+ years). Knowledge of other programming languages like C# is a plus.
* Solid knowledge of Windows architecture and internals.
* Hands on experience in Windows UI- and business logic development.
* Hands on experience in crash dump analysis.
* Hands on experience in agile development methods.
* Knowledge of common source control systems.
* Fluent verbal and written communication skills in English.

What we can offer:

We are offering long term full time employment as an independent contractor, working in an interesting field as part of a growing multi-cultural company. You will have flexible work hours providing the short daily meetings are covered. Your job will be completely location independent, assuming you have access to a reasonably fast and stable internet connection.

Interested?

Great! Please send an application including the following information:

* A short resume covering your previous 5 years of employment along with short descriptions of the main tasks you were responsible for.

* Please don't hesitate to include references to your previous work.

* Your salary expectations.

We are looking forward to your applications!

ABOUT EMSISOFT

Emsisoft is a cybersecurity company. Established in 2003, we’re on a mission to make the online world a safer place through technology, innovation and a healthy dose of empathy. Our award-winning Windows endpoint security solutions are trusted by individuals, businesses, schools, hospitals and governments across the globe.

Emsisoft is a 100% remote company with a team of about 40. Free from geographical limitations, we’re able to recruit talent from all four corners of the globe. Not only does this allow us to assemble the best minds in the biz, it also makes us a uniquely diverse bunch.

We hire on merit and merit alone, and our recruitment processes are intentionally designed to eliminate bias. We reward our employees for their hard work, we’re staunch advocates of maintaining a healthy work-life balance and we look out for each other like one, big, malware-obsessed family.

description:
Looking for expert level programmers for Game/Simulation/AI Development

Now, our small team is working on a "building/simulation/theme park game" for over a year now we call "The Simulation".

We have most of the systems we need in place including building, inventory, time management, saving/restoring, SIMs-like smart objects, character creator, commerce, animation, character AI based on needs (like SIMs), and a nice VCS + automated testing and build suite we use to make our lives better.

title: MVP Of University Students Scholarship Blockchain Platform
description:
Current organizational processes within the educational sector are inefficient by todays’ technological 
standards as they lack from transparency, are costly for all involved stakeholders due to the high 
transactional costs be it time or money, have poor storage means, suffer difficulty organizing , validating 
and transfer of data and money due to involvement of intermediaries such as banks with respect with 
the latter problem raised, have inefficient issuance and renewals of contracts in todays fast paced and 
convenience striving society.
This problem is exemplified year in and year out as the academic years of institutions such National 
University of Lesotho and others are disrupted and delayed due to strikes lead by students and more 
rarely the very tertiaries often leading to damage of property as is common practice tuition and living 
allowances are delayed in being paid out due to the delay of sharing and consolidating records on who is 
to be paid for having been properly accepted, registered and qualified for sponsorship and schooling. 
Lack of transparency is an existing problem as there is often miscommunication with regards to the 
actual stage of processing of data or funds which is often linked with the mismanagement of funds.
Sponsors also suffer with the storage of data as people have made it common practice to destroy 
contracts or records of the enrollment by burning evidence at insignificant costs, this leads to the 
decline in student loan repayments and incur high transactional costs from intermediaries such as 
banks. Students incur high transactional costs (money and time) facilitate the registration and renewal 
of contracts which comes at a huge distress as most students depend on the very money they are expected to facilitate all educational responsibilities and while they and lectures bare the heaviest 
burden in compensating for lost time of the academic year as they have to cover study material in a 
shorter time frame. 
This problem not only exists in Lesotho but is a problem globally as in South Africa, a student was 
incompetently sent more money than she was due and spent it which led to her being jailed for a 
situation she did not original instigate but was inefficiency in the processes of NSFAS.
Solution for problem
A distributed digital ledger that will serve as a platform for secure storage and seamlessly transfer 
information among all invested stakeholders and facilitate all necessary payments. It will be designed to 
give resisted access and different levels of authority and function to each stakeholder with respected to 
their role within the whole process. This proposed platform will make use of digital identities 
(signatures), and smart contracts that will execute autonomously once preset conditions are met. These 
very stakeholders operating on the network will/can participate on the network as nodes, validating and 
monitoring over the transactions that transpire among participants of the potentially earning them 
rewards. This platform would be hosted by existing blockchain platforms such as Ethereum, Polygon or 
Cardano in order to provide the best possible service.
Current Position
Having conducted a feasibility study amongst all invested stakeholders including Ministry of 
Communication, Science and Technology, Ministry of Development planning, NMDS(sponsors) National 
University of Lesotho (in place for tertiary institutions) and students, Omerta is convinced that a 
software of this ilk would be appreciated and integrated with time as the sentiment of approval and 
excitement was shared by the above mentioned stakeholders which constitute both the demand and 
supply side of production. With this in mind, Omerta is in the development phase of the software 
solution for the problem stated above with the existing decentralized App intended for this problem 
having a prototype but with limited functionality.
Requirements
⮚ Access to finance
⮚ Project engagement with Comnet to boost institutional relevance
⮚ Project engagement with Comnet to improve technical approach
Type "I understand" in beginning of your proposal and also put a raw estimation of a costs of such platform. Proposals without this word and estimation of a budget will be rejected.
To make It short : we need to make data transfers and payment transfers between university and students be paperless and secured in blockchain network

title: Develop a News Analysis and Counter-Narrative Dashboard using GDELT, GPT, and DALL-E
description:
We are looking for a skilled developer to create a comprehensive dashboard that leverages the GDELT dataset (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/GDELT_Project), GPT (OpenAI), and DALL-E (OpenAI) to analyze news in Nigeria. The dashboard should be able to intake GDELT media daily, allow users to read and tag articles with sentiment scores, automatically train the GPT model, and provide summaries and trends on a weekly, monthly, quarterly, and yearly basis with charts. Additionally, the dashboard should be able to generate counter-narratives for negative trends to persuade the audience to be more pro-democracy policy.

Responsibilities:

Develop a dashboard that fetches data from the GDELT dataset daily, focusing on articles related to China, Russia, trade, debt and labor policy in Nigeria.
Implement functionality for users to read and tag articles with sentiment scores on the dashboard.
Integrate the OpenAI GPT API to automatically train the GPT model based on the tagged articles and sentiment scores.
Implement a feature to generate summaries and trends using the GPT model and display the results as weekly, monthly, quarterly, and yearly charts.

Utilize the GPT API to create counter-narratives for negative trends in order to promote a pro-democracy policy stance.

Integrate the OpenAI DALL-E API to generate images corresponding to the generated counter-narratives.
Ensure the dashboard is user-friendly and responsive across different devices.

Provide documentation and support for the implemented features.

Requirements:

Proven experience in Python programming and web development.
Knowledge of GDELT, GPT (OpenAI), and DALL-E (OpenAI) APIs is required.
Experience with data visualization and charting libraries (e.g., Chart.js, D3.js, or similar).
Strong understanding of web technologies such as HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
Experience with web frameworks (e.g., Flask or Django) is preferred.
Strong communication and time management skills.
Deliverables:

A fully functional dashboard that fetches, analyzes, and summarizes GDELT data related to policy issues described earlier in Nigeria.
Implementation of user tagging for articles and sentiment scores.
Integration of the OpenAI GPT API for model training, summary generation, and trend analysis.
Integration of the OpenAI DALL-E API to create images for generated counter-narratives.
Responsive and user-friendly design for the dashboard.
Comprehensive documentation and support.

I am an online tutor who helps groups of kids improve their English writing skills. We have used Google Docs primarily. Because the kids sometimes become distracted, I need to see when they last edited the document to make sure they are staying focused on their work. If the "last edited" text reads that a student hasn't made a change in more than a minute, I know to check in with the student or remind them to keep working. 

However, now that Google has moved the "last edited" text to a place where I need to actively hover over a part of the page, I cannot easily see when a student in the class is not focusing on their writing. 

I need a solution that allows to me to easily see when a Google doc was last edited. Ideally, a stopwatch that resets every time the document is edited would be great. Or perhaps, an external dashboard where I can see last edited pages for a selected group of Google Docs. 

I don't know what the best way to solve the problem is, so I am open to ideas.

There is definitely a lot of opportunity for further work to expand on ideas I have to assist me and our other tutors in other areas of the business. 

Thank you!

title: SQL Developer for Postgres SQL Transformations
description:
We are healthcare recruitment platform based in the UK, seeking a skilled SQL Developer to join our team to work on a project to migrate our Google Sheets product data analytics table into Postgres.

We have a large number of data tables that we currently output to Google Sheets directly from our product. These data tables are then transformed using complex Excel formula. This includes, for example, joining data from two data tables within one Google Sheet.

We are hitting a number of performance and size limitations within Google Sheets, so are looking to build a more performant and scaleable solution within Postgres by doing the following:.

1) Migration from Product to Raw Postgres DB
2) Postgres transformation from Raw to Transformed (SQL)
3) Transformed Postgres migrated to Google Sheets for analytics.

You will be responsible for Step 2 - building a series of intermediate SQL transformations within Postgres for export into Google Sheets.

This is an initial 10-15 hour project with potential for ongoing maintenance and new projects following on from this.

Responsibilities:

- Write SQL queries from a Postgres SQL database to build a series of transformed tables which will be exported to Excel for analytics
- Collaborate with the team to design and implement SQL transformations, including Joins, Counts, Aggregations, Filters, and more
- Troubleshoot any issues that may arise during the transformation process
- Ensure all transformations are optimized for performance and scalability
- Work closely with other teams to ensure the data is correctly transformed and exported
- Maintain and update the SQL queries as needed

Requirements:

- Excellent knowledge of SQL and experience with Postgres database architecture, minimum 2 years experience
- A good understanding of Excel formula, to be able to translate Excel formula into SQL
- Experience working with large data sets and designing database schemas
- A strong understanding of SQL best practices and database architecture
- Familiarity with Postgres limitations and the ability to optimize queries accordingly
- Excellent written and spoken English communication skills
- The ability to work in a fast-paced environment and respond quickly to requests and changes

To be considered for this role, candidates will be required to complete a short assessment to test their SQL and Excel skills. This will help us to understand your proficiency level and ensure it is matched to what the project requires.

title: 3D Sensor Specialist for a Foot Scanner Technology
description:
I’m looking for an engineer that has a strong background in 3D image processing that can take care of the post processing process of my project. The idea is ask the patient to stand on top of the glass of the scanner, the RealSense cameras will have the complete vision of the foot through the use of mirrors (as you can see in the pictures attached) and capture independently both feet’s soles in order to generate a 3D model along with the RGB camera integrated in the RealSense. The goal of the 3D model is to generate an insole so is important to be very precise to capture the size of the foot and depth of the foot’s arc. Our preview engineer couldn't continue in our project but he was able to capture a point cloud using this model se we believe is possible to generate the 3D through this way, you can see the generated model in the pdf attached. 

We will provide remote access to a computer that is connected to the hardware so no hardware is needed to be sent. Also we would like to keep in close communication with the engineer so a weekly meeting is expected.

The post processing process of the 3D image should:
- Automatically limit the model to the sole of the foot.
- Fill the “holes” (not captured areas) that could be present. For example, between fingers and other areas.
- Sharp the edges of the foot. We don’t want to see “bites” on the edges.
- Capture correctly the depth of the arc and the size of the foot.
- The scan process should not take more than 7 seconds. 
- Achieve the highest sharpness possible given by the RGB camera inside RealSense. We would like to see the details like calluses or injuries.

Deliverables:
- The generated output should be in .obj or.stl format.
- Three 3D models should be generated at the end: 
• A 3D model that could be 3D printed. We will use it to verify if the arc and size matches the captured foot and for generating the insole.
• A separate model where we should be able to see in a scale of colors the proximity to the glass where the person is standing. Red being the closest to the glass and blue the farthest. This is important for us as it could indicate where more pressure is.
• A 3D model merging the RGB image captured.
- All 3D models should achieve the expected quality described before.
- Source code and documentation.
- We will have a separate 2D camera connected to the computer with high resolution, we would like to have an image in JPEG from it as part of the process.

Technologies proposed to be used:
- Open3D library.
- Python 3.
- Intel RealSense SDK.

description:
# What is DataWars #
DataWars is a Data Science education platform that focuses on explaining concepts throughout interactive projects.

# Project definition #
Your job will be to create a project for our platform on the topic: Filtering and Sorting Pandas DataFrames. You’ll be using a Dataset of FIFA 22 Players (see attached).
You’ll have to create different interactive activities for our students that validate that they know the concepts of filtering and conditional selection with Pandas.

Your project should be structured in the following sections:
1) A quick overview of the dataset, including a few visualizations of the columns to understand the data.
2) Basic selection using simple comparison operators (greater than, smaller than, equals, etc).
3) Selection combining boolean operators AND (&), OR (|), NOT (~). `df.loc[(df["COLUMN 1"] == 150) & (df["COLUMN 2"] == "Red)]`
4) Selection of values that are duplicate and contain null values.

We want you to be creative with the activities that you include, in order to make it engaging for our students. Your project should include AT LEAST 15 activities/questions (of which, at least 10 should be Jupyter/interactive activities).

All your activities should have thoughtful solutions explaining the process to solve them, as well as alternatives if possible.

# Important Considerations #
We are very strict with the format of our projects, so BEFORE YOU ACCEPT this offer, we ask you to do the following two things:

## a) Complete the projects we already have posted ##
Use the invite code `upwork` to sign up for a free account at https://beta.datawars.io. Complete the project titled “Practicing filtering sorting with Pokemon” (https://beta.datawars.io/module/54b07e96-f0da-4b5d-ba40-c87475e42b8e).

## b) Review the handbook for Project Creators ##
Our projects are created with a special syntax combining Markdown and special HTML tags. Please review it carefully to make sure you understand the format and you agree to create the project following it.

https://github.com/datawars-io-content/content-creator-handbook

# Are you ready to accept this job? #
You’ll be creating the project in our Github account, so please send us your Github username so we can give you access to your project's repo.

# What's next? #
If you enjoy creating these type of practical projects, you can become a content creator at DataWars. We have hundreds of cool project ideas for our students, and we'd love to have you onboard in the team working with us. Consider this project as a check to see how well we work together.

title: Product/market analysis of a marketplace of plugins for popular CMS
description:
I need to analyze a marketplace of plugins for popular CMS. 

The analysis aims to find 5+ categories of plugins where we can see relatively high demand but poor-quality supply. To do this, you will need to consider factors such as rating, the number of 1-star-marks, buggy products, and the lack of recent maintenance despite recent downloads, a ratio of marks to downloads, anything else that you can prove useful and find insights there. 

This task is not about a straightforward implementation of a specific request, it is consulting and creating an analytical approach to help me achieve my business goal: find a promising niche in the marketplace.

What data do I have for plugins: 
- 40000 plugins at all
- Title, URL, Description
- Author name and link
- Version of CMS, the current version of a plugin, PHP versions, etc
- Active installations, Total number of all-time downloads, and downloads per last week
- Count of opened/resolved support tickets
- Rating, amount of 1-star-marks, 2-stars, …, 5-stars
- Tags - each plugin has ~3.9 tags (we have 16000 unique tags). Plugins with 100K+ downloads have ~4.5 tags on average. 
- For plugins with 100K+ downloads, I took their tags (3200 tags) and calculated amount of common plugins for each possible pair of tags.
- There are ~2200 plugins with more than 100K downloads

Project structure

I propose dividing this task into 2 parts: classification/clusterization and finding promising clusters.

1. Clusterization

Currently, there are no categories in the dataset. I would like to combine all these tags into categories. I expect to have 100-200 categories. 
You can use my “common plugins” table or you can do it your way. These categories should group plugins with similar features and use cases together. 

NOTE: Tags for tags-pairs in common_plugins were taken from tags that have plugins with 100K+ downloads. But plugins for common_plugins were calculated within all plugins.
Deliverable here is a table of plugins-to-category mapping/association. Let me know if you think that tags-to-category mapping will be more suitable here.

2. Analyzing categories

As told, analyze the categories needed to identify those that have relatively high demand but poor supply. By poor supply, I mean lower marks than similar categories have, buggy products, and no recent maintenance despite recent downloads. But I expect that you can propose additional/other metrics for finding an “unsatisfying supply”.

Some objectives: 
- I am interested in categories where the top 4-6 plugins have more than 100K downloads each
- I would like to avoid categories with defined monopolists (more than 70% of downloads in a category belong to the top-1 plugin; top-1 has more than x3 downloads compared with the next most popular plugin in a category)
- Deliverable here is a list of categories with relatively high demand and poor supply, as well as data-driven proof of dissatisfaction that these categories bring to users. Include comparing these categories with common marketplace trends or with similar categories.

I will provide a 200-plugins CSV example and a sample of the “common_plugins” table in the chat when you text me. 

I am looking for a creative problem solver to join me in this challenge. I can't wait to see how you'll approach it, apply now!

title: OpenAI ChatGPT Expert
description:
I know that ChatGPT is not ready for public use yet but I would like to train it to mimic my style and responses so that when it is ready I can apply for it's use commercially. 

I am a therapist. I have no technical knowledge. I would like a simple interface setup so that I can train ChatGPT to respond in my style. Then later I would like reviews by you to make sure the training is working. Then later I would like your help to integrate the trained bot into my commercial platform. 

I am looking for someone that has a lot of experience with OpenAI perhaps with GPT-3 that can help me set this up. 

I am an anxiety expert. I help coach and counsel people all over the world with a very unique approach to overcoming anxiety. 

To elaborate, I would like you to create a simple and user friendly way for me to train ChatGPT. I work with clients every day so I would like to use those real world clients and conversations to train ChatGPT. I am thinking I would like a simple online interface that would help me do that. In other words, I would like an expert to setup an interface I can use to train the bot on my own and then maybe help me in the future by checking to make sure the training is going well and then helping when we are ready to go commercial. 

I do therapy with clients for anxiety and I want to pass all of that real experience on to future clients. I'd like to train ChatGPT to do anxiety therapy but in my style and as close to my method as possible. I am aware of all the legal issues. I will be making full disclosure to clients per OpenAI regulations so they will know they are chatting with a bot. I will also eventually want to create some courses the bot can take people through. 
For right now though, all I really want to discover is if it is even possible to train a bot to respond using my unique approach - to respond similar to how I would. I want something I can train and test. So I need an interface to enter submission for training but I also need to be able to ask the trained bot questions to see how it is progressing. 

I really don't want to submit .csv files every day or anything like that. What I want is a simple user interface where I can input what my client said and then what I replied then submit it for learning. Then test the bot to make sure it did in fact learn. 

To reiterate, I'm just looking for a simple user interface so I can train ChatGPT on my own without all the technical knowledge. And then a box or something where I can test and measure the progress of training. I'd like you to set that up and then maybe check on it from time to time to make sure it is going well. Once OpenAI allows commercial use then of course I will want you to help me incorporate it into a platform and app.

title: Statistics
description:
Consider a manufacturing plant that produces high-quality products primarily using skilled labor. They are concerned about defects found in the surface coating for their product and have been provided a dataset containing quality ratings for a sample of products. Note that each prompt below may require more than one visualization and/or analysis to fully answer.
1. Conduct an initial exploration of the data and summarize any key features. This must include, but is not limited to, 1) descriptive statistics, 2) features of the response variable, and 3) identifying any limitations of the dataset such as missing data or outliers.
Note that this evaluation should include some visual exploration of the data (i.e., histograms, box plots, scatter plots, etc.).
2. The current performance target is a quality rating of 85.0. Do the data suggest that they are currently meeting this requirement?
3. Is there a significant difference in the average surface quality ratings for products produced on each of the two Production Lines?
4. Is the variation in surface quality consistent across the two Production Lines?
5. Observations showed that employees were using different methods to apply the surface coating. Are there any significant differences in the resulting quality ratings from each of these methods?
6. They currently have four teams of employees with different levels of experience that affect the quality of the products they produce. Is there evidence that there is a significant difference in the average surface quality ratings for products produced on each of the two Production Lines when controlling for the differences in teams?
7. What conditions (i.e., combinations of Line, Team, and Method) are associated with the best and worst product quality ratings?

Anyway - there isn't anything special in doing that code wise - chatgpt know's how to do that. Of course the answer back needs to be in an array (as does the send data).

There are also essay questions where I ask the students to write an example for something. In these type of situations - there is no predefined answers to check with. 

What I would like is that in the questions type editing in LearnDash I could insert the prompt sent to the chatgpt. This is very important.

Regarding the free answers type questions:
These are used by me in the quizzes so students could enter mathematical expressions using a virtual keyboard that was implemented called MathLive (google this). The expressions entered are in Latex.

I also enter predefined answers and this LearnDash does know how to check if the answer is exactly like my predefined answer (to the letter, they have to enter the exact string). The problem is that there are a lot of mathematical expressions that are equivalent. The most simple example "x+y" is equal to "y+x". This is also true of logical expressions. I can't enter all the multitude options of the equivalent correct answers in the predefined answers. What I want is for the students answer and my predefined answer to be sent to chatgpt with the prompt to ask whether they are equal or logically equivalent. I've already tested this in chatgpt and it works great.

It's just a matter of customizing the questions in LearnDash and send an API call in chatgpt.
